newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska corn, sorghum harvest progress quickly.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska corn, sorghum harvest progress quickly.

text.p: Corn and sorghum harvest in Nebraska made good progress during the week ended November 3, according to the latest crop report from the state's Agricultural Statistics Service.
Corn was nearly three-fouths combined, with 71 percent of the crop harvested. That figure compared with 73 percent last year and the five-year average of 70 percent.
Sorghum grain harvest was 59 percent complete, well behind 98 percent last year and 10 days behind the average of 82 percent, the report said.
The winter wheat crop was rated 66 percent good to excellent, 30 percent fair and 4 percent poor.
Topsoil moisture was rated one percent very short 23 percent short, 73 percent adequate and three percent surplus.
